name: Update Generated Docs
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prompt:
        description: "Prompt for Claude Code"
        required: true
        default: "Update generated documentation files"
      branch:
        description: "Branch to create PR from"
        required: false
        default: "update-generated-docs"

jobs:
  update-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libssl-dev libffi-dev python3 python3-pip
          
      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: ${{ github.event.inputs.prompt }}
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          settings: |
            {
              "model": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
              "max_turns": 1,
              "timeout_minutes": 10
            }
          
      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.claude.outputs.execution_file != null
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "docs: update generated documentation"
          title: "Update Generated Documentation"
          body: "Automated documentation update from Claude Code"
          branch: ${{ github.event.inputs.branch }}
          delete-branch: true
